select cm.chat_session_id as id, max(cm.id) as number from sys_chat_message cm inner join sys_chat_session cs on (cm.chat_session_id = cs.id and cs.active = 1 and cs.biz_type = #{bizType} and cs.biz_id in
#{bizId} ) left join sys_chat_entity_session ces on (cm.chat_session_id = ces.chat_session_id and ces.user_id = #{userId} and ces.active = 1) where cm.active = 1 and (ces.clear_ind = 0 or ces.id is null)
and cm.id > coalesce(ces.last_read_message_id, 0)
group by cm.chat_session_id order by coalesce(max(ces.top_ind), 0) desc, max(ces.top_at) desc, number desc

select cm.chat_session_id as id, count(cm.id) as number from sys_chat_message cm where cm.active = 1 and exists (select 1 from (
select #{request.chatSessionId} as targetChatsessionId, #{request.lastReadMessageId} as targetLastMessageId, #{request.clearAt} as targetClearAt ) t where cm.chat_session_id = t.targetChatsessionId and cm.id > t.targetLastMessageId and cm.created_at > t.targetClearAt) group by cm.chat_session_id
